heading.title: Conditions Requisite for Initiation of Proceedings

article.title: Procedure for witnesses in case of threatening, etc.
article.content: A witness or any other person may file a complaint in relation to an offence under section 232 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
article.html:
216Procedure for witnesses in case of threatening, etc.

Section 216 · Chapter XV

A witness or any other person may file a complaint in relation to an offence under section 232 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
